notes.title: Slam Fighter 2.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Slam Fighter 2.0.1 Hotfix:


    Fixed a bug related to retrying from Game Over
    Implemented high score leaderboards
    Added more recognized diss phrases


Now you can show your friends just how good at smack talk you really are!  Maintain beat accuracy and use real words to get the highest possible score!
